policy: Inspect source visually before design writes.
Use only fresh Page 24 components and new components created for this redesign.
No application implementation before the full screen set is reviewed.
Google and email are the supported sign-in methods; no invented Apple, SSO, team or API-key product.
Public pricing reflects bounded free testing. Future paid checkout/receipt examples remain separate in the workflow design.
Contact support opens an email draft; opening an email app is not a sent or received ticket.
Legal page copy is taken from existing repository pages, with its existing date. It is not a new legal approval.
Safe same-origin post-auth return and account ownership checks precede private rendering.
New /app and /product routes are proposed design routes; existing legacy identifiers require an authoritative resolver, not ID rewriting.

sources.used: public home and sign-in dialog hierarchy
documentation navigation, reading width and article hierarchy
public navigation and pricing hierarchy; Krea prices and offers were not copied
reachable authentication failures and recovery categories
email handoff semantics; no server-side ticket delivery
creation, history, ownership and recovery behavior
